name: Jesus Being Humble
overview: Scripture reveals Jesus' humility through His meek and lowly heart, inviting us to learn from Him and find rest for our souls (Matthew 11:29). His compassion moved Him to serve others, teaching and caring for people who lacked guidance (Mark 6:34), and He exemplified humility by coming not to be served but to minister and give His life as a ransom (Mark 10:45). Jesus consistently submitted to the Father's will, doing only what He saw the Father do (John 5:19), demonstrating a perfect model of humble obedience rooted in love (John 3:16).
